our_title: 0d878bdd swapped the output map names of the two bump.grf gmap tests in src/check/Makefile
ran: Pristine v7.0.18 src/check/Makefile:718-719 read; patched G30 trees: flock make check runs '../../bin/gmap data/bump.grf ../../tgt/h3.tgt /tmp/bump_h3.map -vmt' and '../../bin/gmap data/bump.grf data/sub_dist_mesh2d.tgt /tmp/bump_sdm2d.map -vmt' (check_build.log, check_build64.log), rc=0; CMake twins gmap_bump_h3 / gmap_bump_sdm2d (CMakeLists.txt:580,582) already use these names and pass (ctest 172/172).
evidence: Makefile:718 '$(EXECS) $(SCOTCHBINDIR)/gmap data/bump.grf $(SCOTCHTGTDIR)/h3.tgt $(TMPDIR)/bump_sdm2d.map -vmt'; :719 '$(EXECS) $(SCOTCHBINDIR)/gmap data/bump.grf data/sub_dist_mesh2d.tgt $(TMPDIR)/bump_h3.map -vmt'; CMakeLists.txt:580 'add_test(NAME gmap_bump_h3 ... ${tgt}/h3.tgt bump_h3.map -vmt)', :582 'add_test(NAME gmap_bump_sdm2d ... ${dat}/sub_dist_mesh2d.tgt bump_sdm2d.map -vmt)'.

fix_options.label: a. Swap the two output names back (shipped)
fix_options.summary: bump_h3.map for h3.tgt, bump_sdm2d.map for sub_dist_mesh2d.tgt, as in the CMake twin
fix_options.tested: make check 32/64 rc=0 with the corrected names
fix_options.tradeoffs: none: no other rule reads these files
fix_options.maintainer_fit: one-line test fix; he keeps Makefile and CMake twins identical

upstream_fix_review.details: The new three-level composite test is right: data/sub_dist_mesh2d.tgt is added, the CMake twin (CMakeLists.txt:580-582) renames gmap_bump to gmap_bump_h3 and adds gmap_bump_sdm2d, both pass (ctest 172/172, make check rc=0, 32/64), and the Makefile/CMake commands agree except for the output names, which the Makefile hunk swapped (:718 writes the h3 mapping to bump_sdm2d.map, :719 the sdm2d one to bump_h3.map). Harmless today (no rule reads them back) but misleading for anyone inspecting $(TMPDIR) after a failure.
